log.action: Draw my longsword and attack Cadoc.
log.narration: Turn 1 | Day 2, 7:01 pmStrength checkd20: 16 -- successSteel shrieks from its scabbard as you lung forward, driving the Northland broadsword straight for the slave-driver's throat. Cadoc catches the blade on his heavy hilt with a shuddering crash, but your brute force sweeps his guard aside and bites deep into his collarbone. Blood spurts over his ringmail as he staggers back with a snarling curse, his eyes wide with sudden fury."Kill the Northlander," Cadoc roars, clutching his crimson shoulder while the two chain-bearers close in with raised iron spikes.🔊………

log.action: Demand Cadoc tell me where Valerius is.
log.narration: Turn 2 | Day 2, 7:03 pmIntimidation checkd20: 15 -- successYou step over the broken axle, your bloodied sword leveled squarely at the slaver's throat. Cadoc presses a hand against his torn shoulder, his sneer faltering as he backs against the overturned wagon. "He sits in the gilded spire of Ashenveil, buying sweat and marrow," Cadoc spits, his eyes darting toward his two approaching guards. "You cannot run from his coin, dog, his eyes are on every road!"🔊………

log.action: Use Power Strike against the nearest guard.
log.narration: Turn 3 | Day 2, 7:04 pmStrength checkd20: 18 -- successYou pivot away from Cadoc and swing your longsword in a brutal, sweeping arc at the nearest chain-bearer. The heavy blade crushes through his leather jack and cleaves deep into his chest with a sickening crunch. The slaver drops his collar-chains without a sound and crashes sideways into the frozen mud, lifeless before he hits the ground."Curse your northern hide!" Cadoc yells, backing away toward the shadows of the eastern trail as the remaining guard hesitates in terror.🔊………

log.action: Drive my sword into Cadoc before his guards reach me.
log.narration: Turn 4 | Day 2, 7:05 pmStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYou lunge past the remaining guard, driving the full weight of your body behind a deadly thrust. The steel pierces Cadoc's iron ringmail and punches deep into his chest, pinning him against the wagon wheel. He gasps once, his eyes rolling back as blood bubbles over his gray lips, and his limp corpse slumps into the mud."Madman!" the last slaver screams, dropping his iron chains in terror and bolting into the dark, ash-choked wilderness.🔊………

log.action: Drive my sword into Cadoc before his guards reach me.
log.narration: Turn 5 | Day 2, 7:06 pmCadoc lies motionless in the red mud, his chest split wide and his blood freezing against the wagon wheel. The lone surviving slaver has already fled into the twilight, his boots pounding frantically down the dark wilderness track. Silence returns to the crossroads, broken only by the howling wind and the crackle of burning timbers from the ruined merchant cart.🔊………

log.action: Pursue the fleeing guard into the dark.
log.narration: Turn 6 | Day 2, 7:26 pmWIS checkd20: 14 -- successYou plunge into the dark thickets bordering the wilderness trail, following the heavy crashing of broken branches and frantic breath. The slaver trips over an ash-choked root, tumbling headlong into a frozen gulley with a sharp yell. Before he can scramble to his feet, you close the distance and drive your steel through his back, pinning him to the earth. He twitches once and lies still. You wrench your broadsword free, wipe the blade clean on his coarse tunic, and retrieve a heavy leather coin-pouch from his belt.🔊………

log.action: Retrieve the discarded iron collar-chains.
log.narration: Turn 7 | Day 2, 7:36 pmYou stride back to the ruined cart, the freezing gale tugging at your cloak as you scan the bloody snow. Near Cadoc's frozen fingers lie the heavy iron collar-chains, dark and pitted with rust, forged to drag free men into Valerius's pits. You haul the heavy iron off the mud and coil it over your shoulder with a harsh metallic clatter.As you pull the cold links taut, a folded piece of thick parchment slips from Cadoc's inner tunic and flutters against your boot. The parchment bears a red wax seal stamped with a horned skull, and jagged black ink lays out orders to sweep the crossroads for escaped gladiators.🔊………

log.action: Search the dead guard's body for more items.
log.narration: Turn 8 | Day 2, 7:46 pmInvestigation checkd20: 13 -- successYou roll Cadoc's heavy corpse onto its back with the toe of your boot, rifling through his blood-soaked tunic and leather belt. A fat velvet purse yields a handful of gold coins stamped with the mint of Ashenveil, clinking heavily in your palm. From a hidden welt in his collar, you extract a notched iron key, heavy and functional, designed for the locks on his slave irons.The dead man's eyes stare blindly into the gray twilight, but the sealed parchment tucked in his coat confirms what you feared: Valerius is building a fresh army of pit-fighters in the shadows of the southern metropolis.🔊………

log.action: Read the sealed parchment from Cadoc's tunic.
log.narration: Turn 9 | Day 2, 7:51 pmYou snap the red wax seal with your thumb and unfold the stiff parchment against the cold wind. The jagged script carries the stench of dark ink and colder intent, bearing explicit instructions signed with the mark of Valerius."Bring the Northlander alive if you can, unstrung if you must," the letter reads. "The blood-pits beneath the gilded spire crave fresh iron, and the master's grand ritual demands strong marrow from the northern wastes."🔊………

log.action: Search Cadoc's corpse for more coin or gear.
log.narration: Turn 10 | Day 2, 7:56 pmInvestigation checkd20: 11 -- successYou kick aside the slaver's torn mantle and press your search through his damp inner linings. Your fingers find nothing more than a worn whetstone and a brass ring holding two spare keys for horse-tack. Cadoc carried his fortune in his purse, and his iron gear is now yours.🔊………

log.action: Search the ruined merchant wagon for supplies.
log.narration: Turn 11 | Day 2, 8:16 pmInvestigation checkd20: 16 -- successYou shove aside a heavy splintered beam and haul open the crushed oak chest in the bed of the wagon. Beneath a layer of ruined silk bolts soaked in dark blood, you haul out a oilskin packet containing dried venison and hard tack. Tucked beside the food rests a thick pitch-soaked torch, dry and ready for the dark.🔊………

log.action: Search the ruined merchant wagon for supplies.
log.narration: Turn 12 | Day 2, 8:26 pmYou tear through the rest of the ruined wagon, flipping over heavy crates and kicked-aside canvas sacks. Aside from smashed wine casks leeching red stain into the gray dirt, no other useful gear remains among the carnage. The howling gale drives cold ash across the splintered wreckage, leaving the lonely crossroads silent once more.🔊………

log.action: Take the eastern trail into the Blighted Reach.
log.narration: Turn 13 | Day 2, 10:26 pmYou turn your back on the bloody crossroads and step onto the narrow wagon trail, hauling your cloak tight against the biting gale. The earth turns to sharp obsidian grit beneath your boots, black and lifeless, as the jagged teeth of the Blighted Reach rise up to swallow the sky. An unnatural stillness hangs over the frozen crags, broken only by the distant, hollow groan of shifting rock. Up ahead, where the trail bends past a towering finger of black stone, a low, guttural growl echoes through the frozen fog.🔊………

log.action: Head north along the road into the wilderness.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 2, 11:11 pmPerception checkd20: 12 -- successYou stride past the obsidian monolith, your hand resting heavy on the pommel of your sword as the trail climbs into the desolate hills. The fog thickens, reeking of wet fur and sulfur, before a gaunt shape leaps from the jagged rocks above. A hound the size of a wolf, its skin black and hairless, drops onto the cinder path with a bone-snapping thud. Pale mist vents from its nostrils as it biles red saliva onto the gravel, eyes dead and milky as it flexes long, yellowed claws. It lunges for your throat with a ravenous snarl.🔊………

log.action: Call out a challenge into the freezing fog.
log.narration: Turn 15 | Day 2, 11:12 pmIntimidation checkd20: 15 -- success"Come then, beast!" Korrag roars into the gray gloom. "Come taste Northland iron!"Your booming shout shatters the dead silence of the crags, echoing off the obsidian cliffs like thunder. The monstrous hound halts mid-leap, its yellow claws skidding across the loose shale as the sheer volume of your challenge strikes it with primal doubt. It snarls, lowering its hairless head, but its dead eyes flicker back toward the rocks, its morale visibly shaking before your blade.🔊………

log.action: Swing my longsword in a heavy sweeping arc.
log.narration: Turn 16 | Day 2, 11:17 pmYou chop your heavy blade through the empty fog, the cold air whistling as the steel cuts a lethal semicircle before you. The hound has already bolted into the gloom, its hurried paws clattering over distant shale until the dark swallowing mist claims it entirely. Silence settles back over the blackened crags, thick and heavy. Further up the winding obsidian track, the flickering orange glow of a campfire pierces the gray veil, casting long, twisting shadows against the sheer face of the mountain.🔊………

log.action: Strike at the hesitated hound.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 2, 11:18 pmYour boots crunch hard on the cinders as you step into the gloom, but the hairless brute is long gone into the fog. Only the sharp scent of sulfur and scattered gravel mark where it turned tail.Ahead, the mountain trail winds tighter against the sheer obsidian wall. The flickering orange eye of the campfire burns steady through the freezing haze, less than fifty paces up the crag.🔊………

log.action: Call out toward the flickering light of the camp.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 2, 11:23 pmPerception checkd20: 14 -- success"Show yourself!" Korrag growls into the dark. "Step into the light or be cut down in it!"Your broad voice reverberates against the cold volcanic rock, scattering the drifting ash. For a second, only the crackle of burning pine replies from the ledge above."Keep your steel sheath-bound, Northlander," a rasping voice calls down through the smoke. The shadow of a tall, cloaked figure rises beside the blaze, one hand raised open, the other resting upon a long ash staff topped with a iron lantern. "The Blighted Reach is dark enough without spilling blood over a warm fire."🔊………

log.action: Shout up the trail toward the firelight.
log.narration: Turn 19 | Day 2, 11:25 pm"I walk with iron in my hand and no love for skulkers," Korrag spat, his knuckles white upon his leather-wrapped hilt. "Name yourself before I cross your ledge!"The figure steps closer to the edge of the firelight, the orange glare catching the edge of a iron-studded leather mantle and a gaunt, weathered face carved by deep scars. "They call me Ratchwick," the solitary traveler answers, his voice rough as grinding stones. "A stray wanderer seeking shelter from the night's chill, nothing more. Step up to the flame if you have a mind for warmth, or pass by in the frost."🔊………

log.action: Draw longsword and advance cautiously.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 2, 11:30 pmYour longsword slides from its scabbard with a keen metallic rasp that rings against the obsidian crags. You step cautiously up the narrow, ash-strewn incline, your eyes locked on the gaunt traveler.Ratchwick Duskmantle remains still beside the snapping fire, his gnarled hands resting atop his staff. The light glints off the heavy iron collar at your chest as you reach the ledge, revealing a rough stone nook sheltered from the freezing wind. "A fine blade," Ratchwick observes softly, his dark eyes narrowing as they sweep over your Northlander frame and the blood-stains on your leather armor. "Though steel brings little comfort when the cold volcanic fog settles into a man's bones."🔊………

log.action: Demand the stranger state their name.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 2, 11:32 pm"I gave you my warning, traveler," Korrag growls, lowering the point of his heavy blade toward the man's chest. "State your true name and your business in these wasted crags!"Ratchwick does not flinch from the gleaming tip of your longsword. He slowly spreads his gaunt, dirt-stained hands to show they carry no spell-charms or hidden daggers."I gave you my name, Northlander, Ratchwick Duskmantle," the old wanderer says, his rough voice steady despite the steel at his throat. "I salvage scrap and iron from the dead trade wagons that break along the Ashenveil pass. I seek no quarrel with pit-fighters or blooded warriors."🔊………

log.action: Sheathe my longsword and sit by the fire.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 2, 11:47 pmWith a sharp thrust, you drive your heavy longsword back into its scabbard, the iron ring of steel settling into the freezing air. You lower your broad frame onto a smooth obsidian boulder beside the snapping pine blaze, resting your calloused hands near the heat.Ratchwick Duskmantle nods slowly, relaxing his grip on his ash staff and sinking back onto his own seat of stacked slate. He pulls a small iron pot closer to the embers, the sharp smell of boiling pine-bitters rising with the sparks."Wisely done," Ratchwick grunts, stirring the brew with a peeled twig. "Only fools and dead men sleep cold in the Reach."🔊………

log.action: Lower my longsword and step toward the campfire.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 2, 11:52 pmYou settle deeper into the warmth of the fire, the heat thawing the bitter frost from your knuckles and face. Ratchwick watches you through the curling grey smoke, his dark eyes lingering on the heavy iron collar-chains coiled at your belt."You carry the steel of Valerius's men," the old scavenger says quietly, pointing a bony finger toward your bloody trophies. "Cadoc's hounds usually hunt in packs. If you wear his iron, it means you broke his crew, or they left you for the carrion birds."🔊………

log.action: Inquire about the danger further up the trail.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 2, 12:02 am"What lies ahead on this dark road?" Korrag asks, his voice deep and rough. "Speak plain, scavenger."Ratchwick spits into the snapping embers, the saliva sizzling against the hot pine coals. He gestures north with his gnarled twig toward the choking volcanic haze."Nothing good, Northlander," the old man grunts, his dark eyes wide in the firelight. "The path leads straight into the throat of the Reach. Valerius's iron-shod patrols hold the lower passes, snatching any poor devil with strong lungs and thick muscle. But deeper still, near the jagged peaks... the grey fog breathes with things that were never born of woman. Monsters spawned from the old death-magic."🔊………

log.action: Ask Ratchwick what he knows about Valerius.
log.narration: Turn 25 | Day 2, 12:12 am"What do you know of Valerius?" Korrag asks, his eyes narrowing into slits. "Where does the snake hide?"Ratchwick leaning closer, the firelight casting long, grotesque shadows across his scarred skin. He lowers his voice to a dry whisper that barely carries over the howling wind."He rules Ashenveil from his high, gilded spire," the old scavenger mutters, glancing nervously into the fog. "The lords and merchants there bow to his coin, while his slaver-captains sweep these hills for blood. They say he is no mere priest, but an ancient thing that feeds on the dying. He buys Northlanders by the dozen, dragging them down into the dark vaults beneath the city. None ever walk out."🔊………

log.action: Share a meal from my rations with Ratchwick.
log.narration: Turn 26 | Day 2, 12:32 amYou reach into your pack, pull out a strip of salt-cured meat from your rations, and toss it across the fire pit to the old scavenger. Ratchwick catches the greasy parcel with surprising speed, his dark eyes widening as he sniffs the dried beef before tearing into it with yellowed teeth."Real meat," Ratchwick mumbles through a mouthful, grease shining on his scarred chin. "A rare gift in these blighted crags, Northlander. You have a generous hand for a man who carries so much iron."He swallows hard and leans over his boiling iron pot, using his peeled twig to push a wooden bowl of steaming, dark pine-tea toward your boots."Drink," the old man offers, his voice softening slightly. "It tastes like bitter sap and ash, but it keeps the rot out of your lungs when the fog turns foul."🔊………

log.action: Share a meal from my rations with Ratchwick.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 2, 12:47 amYou break off another chunk of hard slab-bread from your belt pouch and slide it across the hearth-stone toward the old scavenger. Ratchwick grunts his thanks, snatching the dry crust and soaking it deep into his bowl of bitter pine brew before shoving it into his mouth."You feed a man well, warrior," Ratchwick mutters, wiping his greasy knuckles against his wool sleeve. "A full belly makes the cold stone softer. But keep your rations close from here on out; once you cross the high ridge, there is neither game to hunt nor clean water to drink."🔊………

log.action: Share a meal from my rations with Ratchwick.
log.narration: Turn 28 | Day 2, 12:57 amYou pull the last scraps of salted meat from your pouch and hand them over to the gaunt traveler. Ratchwick stares at the offering in surprise, his fingers trembling slightly as he accepts the food and nods his head in genuine respect."You are either a prince in disguise or a madman, Northlander," the old man says, shaking his head as he chews slowly. "Few men share their last meal in the Reach. I will not forget this."He sets his wooden bowl down and digs into his ragged wool tunic, pulling out a heavy, yellowed tooth strung on a leather thong."Take this," Ratchwick whispers, pressing the bone charm into your broad palm. "It came off a hound's jaw deep in the old ruins. Wear it, and the pack might think twice before jumping you in your sleep."🔊………

log.action: Ask what monsters lurk near the peaks.
log.narration: Turn 29 | Day 2, 1:12 am"What kind of beasts haul themselves through the gray fog above?" you ask, your hand resting heavy on the pommel of your longsword. "Speak plain, scavenger."Ratchwick spits into the fire, the black spittle sizzling instantly against the glowing pine coals. "Things built of rot and old sorcery," the old man rasps, leaning closer across the embers. "The corpse-hounds are bad enough, but higher up, the fog breeds screeching horrors with wings of dry skin and claws like rusted iron hooks. Valerius's men call them the Gargoyles, but they are no stone statues. They smell the blood of a living man three leagues away and tear him apart while he still breathes."He points a crooked finger toward the dark, jagged peaks above, where the freezing wind howls like a dying horse."If you go up there, Northlander, keep your steel bare and watch the high shadows."🔊………

log.action: Drink the offered bowl of pine-tea.
log.narration: Turn 30 | Day 2, 1:22 amYou reach down and hoist the wooden bowl, lifting the dark, steaming liquid to your lips. The brew is scalding and tastes violently of sharp resin, charred bark, and bitter ash, but as it coats your throat, a deep heat spreads through your chest and clears the sulfurous sting from your lungs."A fine brew, eh?" Ratchwick chuckles, watching you drain the vessel with a nod of approval. "Strong enough to strip iron, but it keeps the mountain rot from settling in your marrow."A piercing shriek suddenly tears through the freezing fog high above the ledge, sharp and metallic, echoing off the jagged basalt crags. Ratchwick snaps his head toward the dark ridge, his face growing pale as he grabs his iron-lantern staff and hastily pulls his hood low over his eyes."They are hunting early tonight," the scavenger whispers harshly, scrambling back into the deep shadow of the rock wall. "Extinguish the fire, Northlander, or pull your blade!"🔊………

log.action: Leave the fire and climb the trail.
log.narration: Turn 31 | Day 2, 1:42 amWisdom checkd20: 16 -- successYou kick a mound of damp ash over the snaps of pine fire, plunging the narrow ledge into sudden, icy shadow. Leaving Ratchwick huddling in the dark against the stone wall, you draw your longsword with a rasp of steel and press forward into the freezing mist.The rough wagon track narrows to a steep, icy trail winding up the jagged face of the basalt crag. Cold ash clings to your beard and face as the howling wind tears through your furs, blowing blinding clouds of gray dust across the path. Above you, the sharp, metallic screech echoes again, much closer this time, accompanied by the heavy, rhythmic beat of broad, leathery wings slicing through the upper fog.Your sharp eyes catch a sudden movement in the swirling mist directly overhead. A gaunt, stone-gray shape with elongated limbs and broad, bat-like wings drops silently from an upper crag, descending fast toward your exposed back with yellow talons extended."Come down, you filth!" you roar, spinning on your heel and raising your broad blade to meet the swooping horror.🔊………

log.action: Step aside and swing at its throat.
log.narration: Turn 32 | Day 2, 1:43 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYou side-step the plummeting shadow as it swoops from the mist, its sharp talons snapping empty air where your chest stood a heartbeat before. Muscles coiling, you channel the full weight of your Northland rage into a brutal arc, driving the edge of your longsword straight into the creature's thick, leathery throat.Steel bites through tough gray hide and crunching gristle, spraying dark, foul-smelling gore across the frozen stone. The Gargoyle Hound screeches in pain, crashing violently onto the jagged basalt path. It scrambles backward on its clawed limbs, wings thrashing wild gray dust into the freezing air as it turns its glowing yellow eyes upon you with murderous fury.🔊………

log.action: Brace my sword for the descending strike.
log.narration: Turn 33 | Day 2, 1:44 amStrength checkd20: 18 -- successYou set your boots against the frozen obsidian and plant the pommel of your blade against your ribcage, turning the tip straight into the beast's lunging mass. The Gargoyle Hound hurls itself forward in a desperate frenzy, launching its full weight directly onto your braced steel.The longsword drives deep through its breastbone, piercing heart and lung with a horrific crunch of bone. Dark, steaming blood erupts across your gauntlets and chest as the weight of the dying horror knocks you back half a pace. With a harsh grunt, you twist the hilt violently and kick the thrashing brute off your blade, sending its lifeless body tumbling over the cliff edge into the dark abyss below.Silence settles back over the narrow mountain trail, broken only by the whistling wind and your own ragged breath. High above, the trail continues its steep ascent through the gray, drifting fog toward the jagged upper ridge.🔊………

log.action: Lunge forward and thrust into its chest.
log.narration: Turn 34 | Day 2, 1:45 amYou fling yourself forward, driving the tip of your longsword through the creature's ribs to ensure it stays dead. Steel bites into lifeless, gray stone-hide with a dull thud, piercing empty air as the corpse lies silent and ruined on the frozen trail.Wiping the dark, foul gore from your blade against your wool sleeve, you sheath the weapon with a sharp click. The freezing ash sweeps across the narrow track as you turn your eyes back toward the high pass ahead.🔊………

log.action: Scour the edge of the cliff for sign.
log.narration: Turn 35 | Day 2, 2:10 amWisdom checkd20: 15 -- successYou drop to one knee at the edge of the precipice, your broad hand brushing away the drifting gray ash from the frozen obsidian stone. Beneath the powder, sharp claw-marks are gouged deep into the rock, accompanied by dark, frozen droplets of black blood leading away from the ledge and curling upward along a hidden goat-path that bypasses the main trail.Beside a jagged outcropping, you spot a dropped iron lantern, its glass shattered, stamped with the same horned skull seal you saw on Cadoc's parchment. Fresh, heavy boot-prints lead from the smashed lantern into the narrow, dark fissure in the cliffside.🔊………

log.action: Examine the frozen bloodstains on the rocks.
log.narration: Turn 36 | Day 2, 2:25 amWisdom checkd20: 14 -- successYou lean close over the frozen stains, scraping a flake of the dark crust away with the tip of your dagger. The blood is unnaturally thick, almost black, smelling sharply of alchemical sulfur and burnt copper rather than the iron stench of living men.It has not fully hardened despite the biting frost, sluggishly oozing like warm pitch where it clings to the obsidian grit. The trail of dark drops leads directly into the narrow fissure, vanishing into the icy shadows of the mountain.🔊………

log.action: Investigate the dark fissure in the cliffside.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 2, 2:45 amWisdom checkd20: 16 -- successYou draw your longsword once more and slide into the narrow fissure, your broad shoulders scraping against the icy basalt walls. The air inside is stifling and hot, choked with the thick stench of sulfur, rot, and stale blood.The crevice opens into a low, damp sea-cave carved into the heart of the crag. Dim red light flickers from a iron brazier near the back, illuminating two heavy iron cages bolted to the rock floor. Inside one lies a sprawling human form, bound in iron chains, its back raw and branded with a glowing crimson rune that pulses in rhythm with a low, sickening hum.Beside the brazier, an iron-clad guard turns sharply at your approach, his hand flying to the hilt of a heavy falchion."Who goes there?" the guard snarls, his eyes widening in recognition as he takes in your Northlander frame. "By Valerius... the pit-fighter from the crossroads!"🔊………

log.action: Follow the hidden goat-path up the crag.
log.narration: Turn 38 | Day 2, 2:55 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYou back away from the cave mouth before the guard can raise the alarm, slipping back out into the freezing wind. Turning toward the hidden goat-path, you begin a steep, perilous ascent up the sheer obsidian crag. Your boots find grip on the narrow, ice-slick ledges, your muscles straining as you haul yourself upward through the blinding volcanic fog. Above you, the trail leads toward a high, windswept ridge overlooking the sulfurous mountain pass, where the dark drops of monster blood vanish into the gray gloom.🔊………

log.action: Demand the guard release the captive.
log.narration: Turn 39 | Day 2, 3:00 amYou drop back down into the mouth of the warm sea-cave, your broad figure blocking the pale light of the crevice. Your knuckles whiten around the leather grip of your longsword as you glare at the iron-clad guard."Unlock that cage," you growl, your voice echoing off the damp basalt walls like rolling thunder. "Unbind the man, or I will paint these rocks with your guts."The guard spat upon the cavern floor, his knuckles white around his falchion's grip as his eyes darted to the pulsing red brand on the prisoner's spine."Valerius pays too well for Northlander marrow, wild man!" the guard sneers, stepping into a low combat stance. "You'll join him in the pit!"🔊………

log.action: Look down through the fog at the pass below.
log.narration: Turn 40 | Day 2, 3:01 amStrength checkd20: 14 -- successThe guard lunges forward, steel singing through the sulfurous air as he seeks to drive his falchion into your belly.You sweep your heavy longsword around in a broad, brutal arc, the iron blade meeting his falling strike with a shower of red sparks. The impact shuddered up his arms, forcing the slaver back a step onto the slick, wet cavern floor."Die, barbarian!" he bellows, recovering his footing and swinging wildly for your neck.🔊………

log.action: Demand the slaver drop his falchion and yield.
log.narration: Turn 41 | Day 2, 3:02 amCharisma checkd20: 18 -- successYou step into his guard, towering over him with bloodlust in your eyes and your heavy longsword poised for a skull-splitting blow."Drop the steel, hound, or I tear your head from your shoulders!" you roar into his face.The guard glances at your cold steel, then at the blood pooling on the basalt, his courage breaking under the sheer weight of your menace. His falchion clatters onto the wet stone."Yield! I yield!" he stammers, backing against the cavern wall with raised, trembling hands. "Don't kill me, Northlander!"🔊………

log.action: Parry the wild swing and counter with Power Strike.
log.narration: Turn 42 | Day 2, 3:04 amYour longsword whips through the damp heat of the sea-cave, the heavy iron tip stopping a hair's breadth from the cowering guard's throat. Cold sweat beads on his pale, filthy forehead as he stares at the sharp steel, his hands trembling violently above his head."The key," you growl, gesturing with your chin toward the heavy iron cages where the branded captive lies silent. "Hand it over before I lose my patience.""It's... it's on the hook by the brazier!" the slaver stammers, his eyes wide with absolute terror. "Take it! Just spare my life, warrior!"🔊………

log.action: Press on toward The Crossroads of Ashenveil.
log.narration: Turn 43 | Day 2, 3:49 amLeaving the terrified slaver trembling against the wet basalt floor, you retrieve the iron key from its iron hook and stride out into the biting gloom. You turn your back on the basalt crag and begin the long descent, your heavy boots crunching through the drifting volcanic ash as you retrace your steps toward the lower pass.The freezing fog thins slightly as the trail winds downward, revealing the familiar jagged splintering of the shattered merchant wagon ahead. You step back onto the rutted dirt of the crossroads, where the cold wind whistles through the bleak timber thickets and snow begins to dust the frozen mud.🔊………

log.action: Unlock the cage to free the captive.
log.narration: Turn 44 | Day 2, 4:34 amRealizing you cannot leave a brother-in-chains to Valerius's dark cruelty, you turn on your heel and stride back up the mountain trail, re-entering the sulfur-choked cavern. The trembling slaver shrinks back against the rock wall as you snatch the heavy iron key from the hook beside the glowing brazier.You cross the cavern in two long strides and shove the iron key into the heavy brass lock of the cage. The rusted tumblers groan and snap open with a harsh metallic clang. You hurl the heavy cage door wide, revealing the broad-backed Northlander lying motionless upon the stone, the dark crimson rune on his spine pulsing with an unholy heat.🔊………

log.action: Unlock the cage to free the captive.
log.narration: Turn 45 | Day 2, 4:36 amYou grasp the thick iron bars and heave the heavy cage door open until its hinges shriek against the cavern floor. The captive inside grunts, his heavy shoulders quivering as he pushes himself up from the freezing stone. The burning red rune on his spine flashes like dying embers, casting a sick crimson glow across the damp basalt walls. He lifts his bearded head, his bloodshot eyes fixing upon your iron collar with a look of dazed, brutal recognition.🔊………
